title: /trigger trash
description: Do /trigger trash to delete the item you are currently holding!
body:
# Trash Slot!
[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/1247254072696897596?label=join%20our%20discord&logo=discord&style=for-the-badge)](https://discord.gg/T5nnUu9CWv)

This mod adds the **/trigger trash** command.


# ❓ What is the point of this datapack?

If you want to quickly get rid of a bunch of items just hold them in your main hand and do **/trigger trash** works in survival with no mods!
